task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Lift the medium-sized bowl for holding food, grab the bowl with brown outer rim, and set the bowl with brown outer rim on the medium-sized bowl for holding food.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架将中型盛食碗提起，抓住棕色外缘碗，并将棕色外缘碗放置在中型盛食碗上。
